title: Allow an alert to be heard when tested using Ascending Volume Profile
body:
### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe. If you select the Ascending Volume Profile, testing an alert will not sound the alert. You will see a message stating that ascending volume profile starts silent. This is a correct statement. However, how is one supposed to test the sound? ### Describe the solution you'd like Please change the behavior so that the alert test would play the sound clip even if the ascending volume profile is chosen. ### Describe alternatives you've considered One has to change the volume profile to test the alarm; then, change the volume profile back after.

![Screenshot_20210514-182023](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/51497406/118337216-50225280-b4e1-11eb-8d5d-b98629a74c10.png)

comments.body: This is a good to have.  But, the work-around works.  I will postpone this.
